text: The delivery fleet should consider transitioning to electric vans. A certified service network and unique quiet curbside branding opportunity make this a compelling choice, especially for companies seeking to differentiate themselves in the market. By adopting electric vans, the fleet can significantly reduce fuel spend and lower operational costs over the long term. Moreover, the success of a courier rival that converted its fleet to electric vans without disrupting operations is a strong indication that electric vans can be safely integrated into a fleet without compromising efficiency. This transition can not only be environmentally friendly but also offer a competitive edge in terms of innovation and new branding opportunities.
